BOOK ONE · LESSON 083

Going on holiday

度假

A dialogue lesson on the present perfect tense (have/has + past participle). Carol and Tom are having lunch; they offer Sam lunch and coffee, but he has already had both. In the living room they are packing their suitcases because they are going to leave tomorrow to have a holiday. Sam says he has already had his holiday this year — he stayed at home. Workbook practice covers comprehension questions and a fill-in exercise with home/school/holiday phrases. Grammar exercises build present-perfect dialogues and rewrite 'want to have' sentences as 'haven't had' explanations.

Lesson 课文

Listen then answer this question. Where did Sam go for his holiday this year?
听录音，然后回答问题。今年萨姆去了什么地方度假？

Listen to the recording, then answer: Where did Sam go for his holiday this year?

  1. 1

    CAROL

    Hello, Sam.
    Come in.

    卡罗尔：你好，萨姆。进来吧。

  2. 2

    TOM

    Hi, Sam.
    We're having lunch.
    Do you want to have lunch with us?

    汤姆：你好，萨姆。我们正在吃午饭。你跟我们一起吃午饭好吗？

  3. 3

    SAM

    No, thank you, Tom.
    I've already had lunch.
    I had lunch at half past twelve.

    萨姆：不，汤姆，谢谢。我已经吃过午饭了。我在12点半吃的。

  4. 4

    CAROL

    Have a cup of coffee then.

    卡罗尔：那么喝杯咖啡吧。

  5. 5

    SAM

    I've just had a cup, thank you.
    I had one after my lunch.

    萨姆：我刚喝了一杯，谢谢。我是在饭后喝的。

  6. 6

    TOM

    Let's go into the living room, Carol.
    We can have our coffee there.

    汤姆：我们到客厅里去吧，卡罗尔。我们可以那里喝咖啡。

  7. 7

    CAROL

    Excuse the mess, Sam.
    This room's very untidy.
    We're packing our suitcases.
    We're going to leave tomorrow.
    Tom and I are going to have a holiday.

    卡罗尔：屋子很乱，请原谅，萨姆。房间里乱七八糟。我们正在收拾行李箱。明天我们就要走了。我和汤姆准备去度假。

  8. 8

    SAM

    Aren't you lucky!

    萨姆：你们真幸运！

  9. 9

    TOM

    When are you going to
    have a holiday, Sam?

    汤姆：萨姆，你准备什么时候去度假？

  10. 10

    SAM

    I don't know.
    I've already had my holiday this year.

    萨姆：我不知道。今年我巳度过假了。

  11. 11

    CAROL

    Where did you go?

    卡罗尔：你去哪儿了？

  12. 12

    SAM

    I stayed at home!

    萨姆：我呆在家里了！

Notes on the text 课文注释

Present perfect tense

在英语中，现在完成时主要用于以下两种情况：(1)表示在过去不确定的时间里发生的并与现在有着某种联系的动作；(2)表示开始于过去并持续到现在的动作。本课中萨姆的3句话属于第一种情况，正是因为他吃了饭、喝过了咖啡、也休过假，因此他谢绝了汤姆的邀请，并表示今年巳无可能再次休假。现在完成时是由 have 的现在式加上过去分词组成。规则动词的过去分词与过去式相同，而不规则动词的过去分词则无统一的规律可言。从本课起不规则动词后还将列出其过去分词的拼写和读音。

I've already had lunch.

注意 already 的语序。在一般情况下，它跟在助动词后面。

Excuse the mess.

意思是："乱七八糟，请原谅。"

have a holiday

度假。have 在不同词组中，意思不同。如：have lunch, 吃午饭；have a cup of coffee, 喝杯咖啡。

stay at home

呆在家里。注意名词 home 之前不加任何冠词。在诸如 go home, arrive home 的短语中，home 是副词。

参考译文
卡罗尔：你好，萨姆。进来吧。
汤姆：你好，萨姆。我们正在吃午饭，你跟我们一起吃午饭好吗？
萨姆：不，汤姆，谢谢。我已经吃过饭了。我在12点半吃的。
卡罗尔：那么喝杯咖啡吧。
萨姆：我刚喝了一杯，谢谢。我是在饭后喝的。
汤姆：我们到客厅里去吧，卡罗尔。我们可以在那里喝咖啡。
卡罗尔：屋子很乱，请原谅，萨姆。房间里乱七八糟。我们正在收拾行李箱。明天我们就要走了。我和汤姆准备去度假。
萨姆：你们真幸运！
汤姆：萨姆，你准备什么时候去度假？
萨姆：我不知道。今年我巳度过假了。
卡罗尔：你去哪儿了？
萨姆：我呆在家里了！

Grammar 语法练习

I. Make up dialogues according to the example. 仿照例句编写对话。

Make up dialogues according to the example. 仿照例句编写对话。
Example: 1. you/have a haircut/last Thursday → When are you going to have a haircut? I have already had a haircut. When did you have a haircut? I had a haircut last Thursday.

Make a present-perfect dialogue from each set of cues, following the example pattern.

Item 1 is a printed example (not editable). Items 2-10 each require four lines of dialogue. Answers are taken from the grammar key (PDF viewer pages 513-514).

II. Give correct explanations for the requests according to the examples. 仿照例句正确解释下列句子。

Give correct explanations for the requests according to the examples. 仿照例句正确解释下列句子。
Example 1a: I want to have a holiday. → I haven't had a holiday.
Example 2a: I want to have some wine. → I haven't had any wine.
